name: OCR 4.1
description: OCR 4.1 is Mistral's document understanding model with improved layout fidelity, block detection, text preservation, checkbox recognition, and right-to-left table parsing.

details.name: improvements
details.value: Improves bounding-box alignment, reference-page structure, block recall on complex pages, double-quote preservation, checkbox recognition, and right-to-left table parsing.

details.name: availability
details.value: The mistral-ocr-latest alias points to OCR 4.1.

sources.notes: Mistral release announcement and linked OCR Playground.

verification.notes: Release details and latest alias were supplied in Mistral's OCR 4.1 announcement; pricing was verified against Mistral's official API pricing page.
